Container.Name: tape-db
Container.Overview: TimescaleDB — Tape's market-data warehouse. ONE neutral template for dev and prod: at creation set Name (tape-db / tape-db-dev), network (br0) + static IP per the §3 scheme (DB takes the lower number in each pair; start before the app), the appdata data path (/mnt/POOL/appdata/tape-db or /tape-db-dev), and POSTGRES_PASSWORD. The tape app's DB_HOST/DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD/DB_NAME must match this container's IP + POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB.
Container.Description: TimescaleDB — Tape's market-data warehouse (one neutral template, dev+prod).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Postgres data dir (set /mnt/POOL/appdata/tape-db-dev/data for a dev container)

Config.Name: POSTGRES_USER
Config.Description: DB user (must match the tape app's DB_USER)

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: DB password (must match the tape app's DB_PASSWORD)

Config.Name: POSTGRES_DB
Config.Description: DB name (must match the tape app's DB_NAME)
